title: WatchDog Mermaid Metadata
description: Node and edge configuration shared by Mermaid pipelines and the node tester.

$schema.description: Supported value: string containing a JSON Schema URI. Default: omitted. VS Code already associates every *.meta.json file through .vscode/settings.json.
$schema.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

string containing a JSON Schema URI.

**Default:** omitted.

VS Code already associates every *.meta.json file through .vscode/settings.json.

target.title: Default capture target
target.description: Supported values: null | screen target object | window target object. This target is inherited by nodes that do not define their own target. A filterless window target inherits the active window stream. Default: null, which requires an already-active stream for pipeline execution.

oneOf.description: Supported values: null | screen target object | window target object. Selected object: use that screen or window as the metadata default target.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

null | screen target object | window target object.

**Selected object:** use that screen or window as the metadata default target.

oneOf.description: Supported values: null | screen target object | window target object. Selected null: do not resolve a metadata target; reuse an active stream. Default: null.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

null | screen target object | window target object.

**Selected null:** do not resolve a metadata target; reuse an active stream.

**Default:** null.

target.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

null | screen target object | window target object.

This target is inherited by nodes that do not define their own target. A filterless window target inherits the active window stream.

**Default:** null, which requires an already-active stream for pipeline execution.

nodes.description: Supported value: object whose keys are Mermaid node IDs and whose values are node metadata objects. Default: an empty object; this schema requires nodes to be declared explicitly.

additionalProperties.description: Configuration for the Mermaid node named by this object key.

nodes.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

object whose keys are Mermaid node IDs and whose values are node metadata objects.

**Default:** an empty object; this schema requires nodes to be declared explicitly.

edges.description: Supported value: object keyed as FromNode->ToNode with edge metadata object values. Each key must match an edge in the adjacent Mermaid file. Default: an empty object; unlisted edges use the next transition type.
edges.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

An object keyed as `FromNode->ToNode`, matching edges in the adjacent Mermaid file.

- Omit `edge_type` or use `next` for the normal path.
- Use `error` for the failure path.

**Default:** `{}`

additionalProperties.description: Configuration for the Mermaid edge named by this FromNode->ToNode key.

propertyNames.description: An exact Mermaid edge key in FromNode->ToNode form. Node IDs may contain letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens, but must start with a letter or underscore.

defaultSnippets.label: Configure Mermaid edge
defaultSnippets.description: Configure an edge whose endpoints exist in the adjacent Mermaid file.

milliseconds.description: Supported value: non-negative integer duration in milliseconds.
milliseconds.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

non-negative integer duration in milliseconds.

point.description: Supported action-target forms: true | string | [integer, integer] | [integer, integer, integer, integer]. This value is the [x,y] fixed capture-local point form.
point.markdownDescription:
**Supported action targets**

- `true` — current recognized box
- `"NodeId"` — saved box from another node
- `[x, y]` — fixed capture-local point
- `[x, y, width, height]` — fixed capture-local area

**Selected form:** `[x, y]`  
**Default:** `true`

prefixItems.title: x
prefixItems.description: Horizontal coordinate in captured-image pixels, measured from the left edge.

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Vertical coordinate in captured-image pixels, measured from the top edge.

region.description: Supported action-target forms: true | string | [integer, integer] | [integer, integer, integer, integer]. This value is the [x,y,width,height] fixed capture-local area form; width and height must be non-negative.
region.markdownDescription:
**Supported action targets**

- `true` — current recognized box
- `"NodeId"` — saved box from another node
- `[x, y]` — fixed capture-local point
- `[x, y, width, height]` — fixed capture-local area

**Selected form:** `[x, y, width, height]`; width and height must be non-negative.  
**Default:** `true`

prefixItems.title: x
prefixItems.description: Horizontal coordinate of the rectangle's top-left corner in captured-image pixels.

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Vertical coordinate of the rectangle's top-left corner in captured-image pixels.

roi.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] in [x, y, width, height] capture-local pixels. Default: [0, 0, 0, 0], meaning the complete captured image. A partially overlapping ROI is clipped to the encoded frame; a non-overlapping or empty ROI is an immediate recognition geometry error.

prefixItems.title: x
prefixItems.description: Horizontal start of the recognition area in captured-image pixels.

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Vertical start of the recognition area in captured-image pixels.

prefixItems.title: width
prefixItems.description: Recognition-area width in captured-image pixels. Use 0 with an all-zero ROI to select the full image.

prefixItems.title: height
prefixItems.description: Recognition-area height in captured-image pixels. Use 0 with an all-zero ROI to select the full image.

roi.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

`[x, y, width, height]` in capture-local pixels.

**Default:** `[0, 0, 0, 0]`, meaning the complete encoded frame.

A partially overlapping ROI is clipped to the frame. An empty or non-overlapping ROI fails immediately.

regionOffset.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] offset in [x, y, width, height] form, added to the source region. Default: [0, 0, 0, 0].

prefixItems.title: x offset
prefixItems.description: Pixels added to the source region's x coordinate.

prefixItems.title: y offset
prefixItems.description: Pixels added to the source region's y coordinate.

prefixItems.title: width offset
prefixItems.description: Pixels added to the source region's width.

prefixItems.title: height offset
prefixItems.description: Pixels added to the source region's height.

regionOffset.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer, integer] offset in [x, y, width, height] form, added to the source region.

**Default:** [0, 0, 0, 0].

rgb.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer] in [red, green, blue] form, with each channel from 0 to 255.
rgb.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer] in [red, green, blue] form, with each channel from 0 to 255.

captureTarget.title: Capture target
captureTarget.description: Supported values: {type:"screen", index?:integer} | {type:"window", process?:string, class?:string, title?:string, capture_area?:"frame"|"client", window_size?:[positive integer, positive integer]}. Chooses the capture source.

oneOf.title: Screen
oneOf.description: Supported capture-target forms: {type:"screen", index?:integer} | {type:"window", process?:string, class?:string, title?:string, capture_area?:"frame"|"client", window_size?:[positive integer,positive integer]}. This value selects a physical monitor; index is the capture API position, not a Windows display number.

type.description: Supported values for capture target type: screen | window. Selected: screen, which captures the monitor at index. No default target type.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported capture target types**

- `screen` — capture a monitor by `index`
- `window` — capture a matched window

**Selected:** `screen` — capture the monitor at `index`.

**Default:** none.

index.description: Supported value: non-negative integer screen index returned by the capture API. Default: 0.
index.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

non-negative integer screen index returned by the capture API.

**Default:** 0.

oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported capture-target forms**

{type:"screen", index?:integer} | {type:"window", process?:string, class?:string, title?:string, capture_area?:"frame"|"client", window_size?:[positive integer,positive integer]}.

This value selects a physical monitor; index is the capture API position, not a Windows display number.

oneOf.title: Window
oneOf.description: Supported capture-target forms: {type:"screen", index?:integer} | {type:"window", process?:string, class?:string, title?:string, capture_area?:"frame"|"client", window_size?:[positive integer,positive integer]}. This value selects a window. Supplied process/class/title regular expressions are combined with AND; omitting all filters inherits the active window.

type.description: Supported values for capture target type: screen | window. Selected: window, which captures a window matched by process, class, or title. No default target type.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported capture target types**

- `screen` — capture a monitor by `index`
- `window` — capture a matched window

**Selected:** `window` — capture a window matched by `process`, `class`, or `title`.

**Default:** none.

process.description: Supported value: string containing a Rust regular expression matched against the executable process name. Default: omitted. Combined with class and title using AND.
process.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

string containing a Rust regular expression matched against the executable process name.

**Default:** omitted.

Combined with class and title using AND.

class.description: Supported value: string containing a Rust regular expression matched against the native window class. Default: omitted. Combined with process and title using AND.
class.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

string containing a Rust regular expression matched against the native window class.

**Default:** omitted.

Combined with process and title using AND.

title.description: Supported value: string containing a Rust regular expression matched against the window title. Default: omitted. Use ^...$ for an exact title; combined with process and class using AND.
title.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

string containing a Rust regular expression matched against the window title.

**Default:** omitted.

Use ^...$ for an exact title; combined with process and class using AND.

oneOf.description: Supported values: "frame" | "client". Selected "frame": capture DWM window bounds including title bar, borders, and client content. Default: "frame".
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

"frame" | "client".

**Selected "frame":** capture DWM window bounds including title bar, borders, and client content.

**Default:** "frame".

oneOf.description: Supported values: "frame" | "client". Selected "client": capture only drawable client content, excluding title bar and non-client borders. Default: "frame".
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

"frame" | "client".

**Selected "client":** capture only drawable client content, excluding title bar and non-client borders.

**Default:** "frame".

capture_area.description: Supported values: "frame" | "client". frame captures complete DWM bounds including borders and title bar; client captures only client content. Default: "frame".
capture_area.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

"frame" | "client". frame captures complete DWM bounds including borders and title bar; client captures only client content.

**Default:** "frame".

window_size.description: Supported value: [positive integer, positive integer] in [width, height] form. This is the expected client/content size in physical capture pixels, independent of capture_area. On the top-level target, WatchDog tries to resize and verifies within two pixels. Default: omitted, so no size preflight occurs.

prefixItems.title: client width
prefixItems.description: Required client/content width in physical capture pixels; must be positive.
prefixItems.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

Integer from `1` through `4294967295`, measured in physical capture pixels.

**Required:** yes  
**Default:** none

prefixItems.title: client height
prefixItems.description: Required client/content height in physical capture pixels; must be positive.
prefixItems.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

Integer from `1` through `4294967295`, measured in physical capture pixels.

**Required:** yes  
**Default:** none

window_size.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[positive integer, positive integer] in [width, height] form.

This is the expected client/content size in physical capture pixels, independent of capture_area.

On the top-level target, WatchDog tries to resize and verifies within two pixels.

**Default:** omitted, so no size preflight occurs.

oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported capture-target forms**

{type:"screen", index?:integer} | {type:"window", process?:string, class?:string, title?:string, capture_area?:"frame"|"client", window_size?:[positive integer,positive integer]}.

This value selects a window.

Supplied process/class/title regular expressions are combined with AND; omitting all filters inherits the active window.

captureTarget.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

{type:"screen", index?:integer} | {type:"window", process?:string, class?:string, title?:string, capture_area?:"frame"|"client", window_size?:[positive integer, positive integer]}.

Chooses the capture source.

candidateSelection.title: Recognition candidate selection
candidateSelection.description: Supported value: object {order?: CandidateOrder, index?: non-negative integer}. Sorts all eligible recognizer results and selects one zero-based candidate. Supported by TemplateMatch, OCR, and Custom; ignored by DirectHit and ColorMatch. Default: {"order":"native","index":0}.

oneOf.description: Supported values: native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc. Selected native: keep recognizer order. Default: native.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc.

**Selected native:** keep recognizer order.

**Default:** native.

oneOf.description: Supported values: native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc. Selected top_to_bottom: center y ascending, then center x, then detection index. Default: native.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc.

**Selected top_to_bottom:** center y ascending, then center x, then detection index.

**Default:** native.

oneOf.description: Supported values: native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc. Selected bottom_to_top: center y descending, then center x, then detection index. Default: native.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc.

**Selected bottom_to_top:** center y descending, then center x, then detection index.

**Default:** native.

oneOf.description: Supported values: native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc. Selected left_to_right: center x ascending, then center y, then detection index. Default: native.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc.

**Selected left_to_right:** center x ascending, then center y, then detection index.

**Default:** native.

oneOf.description: Supported values: native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc. Selected right_to_left: center x descending, then center y, then detection index. Default: native.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc.

**Selected right_to_left:** center x descending, then center y, then detection index.

**Default:** native.

oneOf.description: Supported values: native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc. Selected confidence_desc: confidence descending, then detection index. Default: native.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

native | top_to_bottom | bottom_to_top | left_to_right | right_to_left | confidence_desc.

**Selected confidence_desc:** confidence descending, then detection index.

**Default:** native.

order.description: Supported values: "native" | "top_to_bottom" | "bottom_to_top" | "left_to_right" | "right_to_left" | "confidence_desc". Determines sorting before index selection. Default: "native".
order.markdownDescription:
**Supported values**

"native" | "top_to_bottom" | "bottom_to_top" | "left_to_right" | "right_to_left" | "confidence_desc".

Determines sorting before index selection.

**Default:** "native".

index.description: Supported value: non-negative integer. Zero-based candidate index after sorting. Default: 0.
index.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

non-negative integer.

Zero-based candidate index after sorting.

**Default:** 0.

candidateSelection.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

object {order?: CandidateOrder, index?: non-negative integer}.

Sorts all eligible recognizer results and selects one zero-based candidate.

Supported by TemplateMatch, OCR, and Custom; ignored by DirectHit and ColorMatch.

**Default:** {"order":"native","index":0}.

recognition.title: Recognition
recognition.description: Supported object types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Determines whether the node matches and may provide a detected box used by actions. roi, roi_offset, and candidate_selection belong inside this object. Default at node level: {"type":"DirectHit"}.

oneOf.title: Direct hit
oneOf.description: Supported recognition types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected DirectHit: always matches; useful with a fixed action target. Node default: DirectHit.

type.description: Supported values for recognition type: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected: DirectHit, which always matches and returns the effective ROI as its box. Node default: DirectHit.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

- `DirectHit` — always match
- `TemplateMatch` — locate an image template
- `OCR` — recognize and filter text
- `ColorMatch` — match an RGB range
- `Custom` — invoke a registered recognizer

**Selected:** `DirectHit` — always matches and returns the effective ROI as its box.

**Node default:** `DirectHit`.

roi.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] in [x,y,width,height] form. DirectHit returns this area as its recognized box. Default: [0,0,0,0], which uses the whole image.
roi.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer, integer] in [x,y,width,height] form.

DirectHit returns this area as its recognized box.

**Default:** [0,0,0,0], which uses the whole image.

roi_offset.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] offset applied to roi. Default: [0,0,0,0].
roi_offset.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer, integer] offset applied to roi.

**Default:** [0,0,0,0].

candidate_selection.description: Supported value: {order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}. Default: native order and index 0. DirectHit ignores this field.
candidate_selection.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

{order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}.

**Default:** native order and index 0.

DirectHit ignores this field.

oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom.

**Selected DirectHit:** always matches; useful with a fixed action target.

**Node default:** DirectHit.

oneOf.title: Template match
oneOf.description: Supported recognition types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected TemplateMatch: find template-similar regions, filter by threshold, merge overlapping pixel-shift detections, then sort and select a distinct candidate.

type.description: Supported values for recognition type: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected: TemplateMatch, which locates regions similar to the configured template. Node default: DirectHit.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

- `DirectHit` — always match
- `TemplateMatch` — locate an image template
- `OCR` — recognize and filter text
- `ColorMatch` — match an RGB range
- `Custom` — invoke a registered recognizer

**Selected:** `TemplateMatch` — locate regions similar to the configured template.

**Node default:** `DirectHit`.

template.description: Supported value: non-empty image-path string. Required; no default. Absolute paths are used directly. Relative paths first check %USERPROFILE%/.watch_dog/resources/images and then bundled resources/images.
template.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

non-empty image-path string.

**Required:** yes  
**Default:** none.

Absolute paths are used directly.

Relative paths first check %USERPROFILE%/.watch_dog/resources/images and then bundled resources/images.

threshold.description: Supported value: number from 0 through 1. Minimum normalized template-match confidence. Default: 0.7.
threshold.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

number from 0 through 1.

Minimum normalized template-match confidence.

**Default:** 0.7.

roi.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] in [x,y,width,height] form, local to the captured image. Default: [0,0,0,0], which searches the whole image.
roi.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer, integer] in [x,y,width,height] form, local to the captured image.

**Default:** [0,0,0,0], which searches the whole image.

roi_offset.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] offset applied to roi. Default: [0,0,0,0].
roi_offset.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer, integer] offset applied to roi.

**Default:** [0,0,0,0].

candidate_selection.description: Supported value: {order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}. Sorts and selects one eligible template candidate. Default: native order and index 0.
candidate_selection.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

{order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}.

Sorts and selects one eligible template candidate.

**Default:** native order and index 0.

oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom.

**Selected TemplateMatch:** find template-similar regions, filter by threshold, merge overlapping pixel-shift detections, then sort and select a distinct candidate. `candidate_selection.index` addresses this consolidated list.

oneOf.title: OCR
oneOf.description: Supported recognition types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected OCR: recognize text blocks, filter by confidence and optional expected regex, then sort and select a block.

type.description: Supported values for recognition type: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected: OCR, which recognizes text and filters it by expected regex and confidence. Node default: DirectHit.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

- `DirectHit` — always match
- `TemplateMatch` — locate an image template
- `OCR` — recognize and filter text
- `ColorMatch` — match an RGB range
- `Custom` — invoke a registered recognizer

**Selected:** `OCR` — recognize text and filter it by `expected` regex and confidence.

**Node default:** `DirectHit`.

expected.description: Supported value: string containing a Rust regular expression matched against each OCR block. Unanchored patterns search by substring; use ^...$ for an exact match. Literal spaces tolerate spaces omitted by OCR. Default: omitted, which accepts any text passing the confidence threshold.
expected.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

string containing a Rust regular expression matched against each OCR block.

Unanchored patterns search by substring; use ^...$ for an exact match.

Literal spaces tolerate spaces omitted by OCR.

**Default:** omitted, which accepts any text passing the confidence threshold.

threshold.description: Supported value: number from 0 through 1. Minimum OCR confidence. Default: 0.3.
threshold.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

number from 0 through 1.

Minimum OCR confidence.

**Default:** 0.3.

roi.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] in [x,y,width,height] form, local to the captured image. Default: [0,0,0,0], which submits the whole image to OCR.
roi.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer, integer] in [x,y,width,height] form, local to the captured image.

**Default:** [0,0,0,0], which submits the whole image to OCR.

roi_offset.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] offset applied to roi. Default: [0,0,0,0].
roi_offset.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer, integer] offset applied to roi.

**Default:** [0,0,0,0].

candidate_selection.description: Supported value: {order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}. Selects one OCR block after filtering. Default: native order and index 0.
candidate_selection.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

{order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}.

Selects one OCR block after filtering.

**Default:** native order and index 0.

oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom.

**Selected OCR:** recognize text blocks, filter by confidence and optional expected regex, then sort and select a block.

oneOf.title: Color match
oneOf.description: Supported recognition types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected ColorMatch: match pixels inside the ROI against an inclusive RGB range; the recognized box is the effective ROI.

type.description: Supported values for recognition type: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected: ColorMatch, which matches pixels inside the ROI against an inclusive RGB range. Node default: DirectHit.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

- `DirectHit` — always match
- `TemplateMatch` — locate an image template
- `OCR` — recognize and filter text
- `ColorMatch` — match an RGB range
- `Custom` — invoke a registered recognizer

**Selected:** `ColorMatch` — match pixels inside the ROI against an inclusive RGB range.

**Node default:** `DirectHit`.

lower.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer] RGB channels from 0 to 255. Required; no default. Inclusive lower RGB bound.

[integer, integer, integer] RGB channels from 0 to 255.

Inclusive lower RGB bound.

upper.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer] RGB channels from 0 to 255. Required; no default. Inclusive upper RGB bound.
upper.markdownDescription:

[integer, integer, integer] RGB channels from 0 to 255.

**Required:** yes

Inclusive upper RGB bound.

roi.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] in [x,y,width,height] form. Default: [0,0,0,0], which checks the whole image.
roi.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer, integer] in [x,y,width,height] form.

**Default:** [0,0,0,0], which checks the whole image.

roi_offset.description: Supported value: [integer, integer, integer, integer] offset applied to roi. Default: [0,0,0,0].
roi_offset.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

[integer, integer, integer, integer] offset applied to roi.

**Default:** [0,0,0,0].

candidate_selection.description: Supported value: {order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}. Default: native order and index 0. ColorMatch ignores this field.
candidate_selection.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

{order?: "native"|"top_to_bottom"|"bottom_to_top"|"left_to_right"|"right_to_left"|"confidence_desc", index?: non-negative integer}.

ColorMatch ignores this field.

oneOf.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom.

**Selected ColorMatch:** match pixels inside the ROI against an inclusive RGB range; the recognized box is the effective ROI.

oneOf.title: Custom recognizer
oneOf.description: Supported recognition types: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected Custom: invoke a registered recognizer with recognizer-specific JSON parameters.

type.description: Supported values for recognition type: DirectHit | TemplateMatch | OCR | ColorMatch | Custom. Selected: Custom, which invokes the registered recognizer named by recognition. Node default: DirectHit.
type.markdownDescription:
**Supported recognition types**

- `DirectHit` — always match
- `TemplateMatch` — locate an image template
- `OCR` — recognize and filter text
- `ColorMatch` — match an RGB range
- `Custom` — invoke a registered recognizer

**Selected:** `Custom` — invoke the registered recognizer named by `recognition`.

**Node default:** `DirectHit`.

recognition.description: Supported value: non-empty registered recognizer-name string. Required; no default.
recognition.markdownDescription:
**Supported value**

non-empty registered recognizer-name string.

**Required:** yes  
**Default:** none.

Default: true. Actions execute at the resolved area's center. After offsets, that action point must remain inside the encoded frame; unsafe points fail instead of being clamped or executed.

Actions execute at the resolved area's center. After offsets, the resulting action point must remain inside the encoded frame. Out-of-bounds points fail; they are never silently clamped. `false` is not usable.
